cases.name: absent
cases.what: Nobody has signalled: the row is proven absent.

cases.name: entries_only
cases.what: Two validators support a plan and a third has withdrawn: entries of both forms, no plan.

cases.name: scheduled
cases.what: All four validators support the plan: it is scheduled.

cases.name: activated
cases.what: The activating block: the row is gone, the metadata names version 5, and the next header carries it.

description: Proven upgrade/state rows from the engine (v5/tests/upgrade_node.rs, V5_EXPORT_UPGRADE_FIXTURE=1). Each case holds the answer to /v4/state with include_upgrade, whose root is the application hash of the block at `height` (the header of the next block carries it).
